key_insights: Failed breakouts on BTC and ETH in downtrends are bearish continuation setups, not reversal signals
BTC and ETH need to reclaim 17.5K and 1.3K respectively to turn bullish; otherwise expect range lows to be tested
Crypto remains highly correlated with S&P 500; market participants should wait for SP guidance rather than trading range midpoints
Weekend price action has been garbage (either dead vol or forced selling), making Friday entries into weekend risky
Exchange counterparty risk is significant; diversification across multiple exchanges is prudent
Binance appears solvent but communication is poor; Mazars discontinuing crypto attestations is concerning but likely due to liability concerns
summary: BTC and ETH both experienced bearish failed breakouts above key resistance levels (17.5K and 1.3K), falling back into ranges with potential for range low tests. Crypto remains heavily correlated with S&P 500, which is testing critical monthly support at 3700 after losing 3900. Duck maintains bullish conviction on LTC from bottom despite 20% drawdown, while both hosts agree weekend price action has been garbage. Exchange counterparty risk warrants diversification across multiple exchanges.
